mapper.select: SELECT course_no,is_completed,progress,TO_CHAR(e.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday,title,m.name as instructor,thumbnail FROM course_enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_no=c.no JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE e.member_id=#{member_id} ORDER BY e.regdate DESC

SELECT course_no,progress,title,m.name as instructor,thumbnail,last_accessed FROM course_enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_no=c.no JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE e.member_id=#{member_id} AND last_accessed >= SYSDATE-7 ORDER BY last_accessed DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET password=#{password}, name=#{name}, sex=#{sex}, birthdate=TO_DATE(#{birthdate}, 'YYYYMMDD'), phone=#{phone}, post=#{post}, addr1=#{addr1}, addr2=#{addr2}, profile_desc=#{profile_desc} WHERE member_id=#{member_id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.no,course_no,title,thumbnail,m.name as instructor,price, TO_CHAR(p.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as dbday FROM course_payment p JOIN course c ON p.course_no=c.no JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE p.member_id=#{member_id} ORDER BY p.regdate DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT a.no,course_no,title,thumbnail,m.name as instructor,pay_price,regular_price FROM course_cart a JOIN course c ON a.course_no=c.no JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE a.member_id=#{member_id} ORDER BY a.regdate DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
